source_note: Extracted live from https://ds.web.uta.edu/components (68 components, Sep 24 2026). Character limits are NOT published on the public site and are deliberately omitted here. 'maxImages'/'maxButtons'/links.max/listing.max are upper bounds only, never confirmed as exact-count requirements. 'sharedCopyUnconfirmed' carries forward the original design doc's claim that these Hero variants inherit page-level Title/Description instead of having their own fields -- not something the public catalog structurally confirms. Migrated to a per-field schema (purpose/fields[]/examples) on 2026-09-28 -- field skeletons (fieldType, constraints) are derived deterministically from the same six verified flags this file always had, never invented by a model; `purpose` and `examples` are the only model-written text, grounded in each component's own crawled notes. Reconciled with UTA's newer digital-design-system site on 2026-09-28: components present on both sites merged into one record (new-site name/text wins per explicit precedence, old site fills gaps); old-only components carried over as-is; new-only components added fresh. Added visualVariant/specialFeatures/screenshotAsset/sourceSites -- special features and visual variant are the only additional model-written data, grounded in each component's own scraped 'Page Details And Notes'/'ABOUT THE COMPONENT' text, never invented.

components.purpose: Use Accordion when a page needs to hold a lot of text without making the page itself longer, especially for FAQs, terms and conditions, contest rules, and similar information that is important but does not need to be seen immediately.
